methodology.aggregation: Macro-average per-page scores; null values excluded per metric.
methodology.preprocessing: Both chrome-excluded and chrome-included scores; preprocessing is symmetric.
methodology.chrome_delta: Mean paired included-minus-excluded score; pairs with null values excluded.
methodology.cache_policy: Missing or empty cache files score as empty output when a reference exists.
methodology.reliability: Historical HTTP outcomes are unknown; error rate is null. Cache availability is reported separately.

latency.limitation: Historical latency unavailable; file read time is not scraping latency.

methodology.judge: Skipped; no judge calls or cache changes.
methodology.reference_limitation: Ground truth derives from Engine A; agreement is not independent factual accuracy.

production_weighted.method: Production category shares times evaluation category macro means; chrome-excluded numeric weights renormalized over applicable categories.
production_weighted.limitation: Estimates reference agreement, not measured production accuracy. Renormalized numeric scores describe only categories with applicable numeric references.
